description: Complete seed-0 blobs small-beta shard of the official checkpointed 2D EBM suite and trace Algorithm 1 on the same faithful SOSMC-ULA execution. Exact 10k-particle/1001-step tuning, a shared exact 20k-step reference-particle draw guarded by bitwise reference/config checks, independent multi-grid quadrature for the true 2D reward expectation and KL, particle continuity, one ULA proposal per outer step, nonuniform weights, and an independently reconstructed weighted gradient. Claim 5 is measured but not accepted until the dataset and regularisation evidence is aggregated.
